description: T-1369: ANCHORARRAY over IF(TRUE,A1) with a plain-value A1, IF over a multi-cell range, @IF over a spill anchor and IF with a false condition. D1 spills SEQUENCE(3). Each formula sits in row 1 with empty cells below so a spill can show. The `IF(TRUE,D1)#`, `@IF(TRUE,D1)#`, `ROWS(IF(TRUE,D1)#)` and `ISREF(IF(TRUE,D1)#)` forms cannot be built through excel-graph: the workbook is rejected as unsupported (FileCorruptTryRepair on createSession).
